info.about: Toukiden: The Age of Demons is an action role-playing game developed by Omega Force for the PlayStation Portable and PlayStation Vita. It was released on June 27, 2013 in Japan.
info.trivia: An expanded version of Toukiden with new missions and demons.
info.why: A moderate print run; the PS4 version is more common, so the Vita disc prices above it.
